datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC acute food insecurity phase classifications were collected by FEWS NET enumerators at sub-national administrative units in Yemen on a regular schedule (typically monthly). Spatial data were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats representing medium-term projection scenarios for February, June, and October 2017, providing a geographic record of food insecurity severity for humanitarian response planning.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: FEWS NET enumerators collect IPC classification spatial data on a regular schedule, assigning acute food insecurity phase scores to sub-national geographic units under current and projected scenarios.
